title: Standard Candles
summary: Standardise mission lengths as z-scores, find the extremes, and see what z can't do.
hints: `sum(abs(z_hours) > 3)` counts values more than 3 SDs from the mean, on either side.
Below the mean means a negative z: `mean(z_hours < 0)` gives the proportion. Compare it with 0.5.
